correctness.rationale: PASS: In the unnormalized graph indicator on G=F_q^2, q=2^m, K=2^gcd(m,r), a nonzero horizontal translation a has Gold derivative D_a(x)=a^(2^r+1)+a^(2^r)x+a x^(2^r). Its linear part has kernel aF_K, so each nonempty overlap fiber has K points and each ambiguity coefficient is either 0 or K, with (q-1)q^3/K^2 nonzero such coefficients. For zero translation, quadratic Walsh sums of Q_d(x)=Tr(d x^(2^r+1)) have radical K when m/h odd, and when even have radical K^2 for exactly (q-1)/(K+1) choices d and radical 1 otherwise; Walsh-square orthogonality yields all stated levels/multiplicities. Weyl orthonormality gives singular values q|A_g| (sqrt(|G|)=q) and positive condition number q/K, including u=2 value coincidences. Independently constructed binary-extension-field/Walsh counts q=4,8,16 across r=1,2 agreed with every amplitude multiplicity (e.g. q=16,r=1: amplitudes 0:49995,2:15360,4:160,8:20,16:1; r=2:0:61500,4:4032,16:4). Finite checks corroborate, not substitute for universal radical arguments.
